frozen_rules.hybrid_A_plus_C: Native CAD trace where complete/unambiguous; otherwise 90deg continuation + 60d.
frozen_rules.sump_intersection_rule: Only bar centrelines passing through the sump footprint are depressed. Boundary-only contact is not diverted.
